scope: Anonymous public reads of the Ably (에이블리) fashion marketplace. No account login, no cookies, no writes.

observation.method: Automation Chrome tab via CDP: Document/XHR/Fetch with response bodies; SPA bundle grep for routes not reached by UI clicks
pages: https://m.a-bly.com/ -> 302 to https://mobile.a-bly.com/ (Vite SPA shell, no embedded JSON)
observation.embeddedJson: mobile.a-bly.com documents are an empty SPA shell. m.a-bly.com Next.js pages carry __NEXT_DATA__ with only session context (isLogin) or RSC text; all catalog data comes from api.a-bly.com JSON.
observation.replay: Node 24 fetch, fresh process, 3 s minimum interval; all listed GET routes returned 200 application/json on 2026-10-19

session.withoutToken: 401 application/json {detail: authentication credentials were not provided}
session.cookies: Not required. The token response sets a Cloudflare cookie that the client ignores.
session.antiBot: mobile.a-bly.com static assets answer a Cloudflare managed challenge to non-browser clients; api.a-bly.com JSON did not challenge Node during this check.

response.market_vertical_types[]: {sno, name, query_value:{market_type_sno}|{category_sno}, categories[]:{sno, name, depth, query_value:{category_sno}, categories[]:{sno,name,depth}}}

query.market_type_sno: vertical sno (1 fashion, 2 life, 3 beauty, 4 digital, 27 place); sent together with category_sno by the UI
query.category_sno: category or sub-category sno from ranking-filters
query.last_ranking: rank of the last item of the previous page
query.last_sno: goods sno of the last item of the previous page

response.goods[]: {ranking, sno, name, price, discount_rate, linked_option:{price, original_price, option_names}, sell_count, total_review_count, positive_review_rate, is_soldout, image, first_page_rendering:{cover_image, original_price, price}, market:{sno,name,market_type:{sno,name},style_tags,age_tags}, category:{sno,name}, brand_sno, ad}

endpoints.rankRule: Displayed rank is goods[].ranking; array position is never used. Duplicate rank fails.

query.next_token: opaque base64 token from the previous page

response.components[]: {type:{item_list}, entity:{item_list[]:{item}}}; goods are in components whose item_list type ends with GOODS_LIST (THREE_COL_GOODS_LIST)
response.item: {sno, name, image, market_sno, market_name, market_type, category_name, price, discount_rate, sell_count, first_page_rendering:{original_price, cover_image}, ad (non-null = sponsored)}

response.goods: {sno, name, sku_code, sale_type, cover_images[], price_info:{consumer, base_thumbnail_price, thumbnail_price, discount_rate}, price_description:{text}, market:{sno,name,market_vertical_type}, brand:{sno,name}, display_categories[]:{sno,name,parent_category}, standard_category, positive_review_rate, webview_url}

priceKinds.thumbnail_price: coupon_applied_display (depends on viewer coupons; not a guaranteed price)

endpoints.parse: Image src values inside DESCRIPTION parts only

endpoints.note: No star average is exposed; positive_percent is the rating signal.

query.selected_option_sno: goods_option_sno of the chosen depth-1 value (depth 2 only)

response.name: group name
response.option_components[]: {name, depth, goods_option_sno, is_final_depth, option_minimum_additional_price, goods_option:{option_names, price, original_price, is_soldout} (final depth)}

endpoints.note: Anonymous viewer sees the share-reward estimate (최대 N원 받기) and settlement rate 2; it is a display estimate, not a commission record.

response.item_list[].item: {sno, thumbnail, contents, like:{count}, bookmark:{count}, tagged_goods_count, deeplink}

response.outfits[].item: {sno, contents, images[], thumbnail, tags[], season_tags[], like, bookmark, comment_count, member:{...private fields...}, goods_list[].item:{sno,name,linked_option:{price,original_price},market,category,is_soldout,image}}

endpoints.privacy: member.writer/height/weight are not emitted by the client

response.contents[].item: {sno, title, sub_title, list_thumbnail, opened_at, tags[]:{sno,name}, filter:{sno,name}, deeplink}

response.market_types[]: {sno, name}: 8 쇼핑몰, 7 셀럽, 6 브랜드, 2 라이프, 3 뷰티, 4 디지털

query.next_token: empty on first page in the UI; numeric string afterwards

response.markets[]: {rank, last_rank, sno, name, instagram, style_tags, age_tags, favorites_count, market_type:{sno,name}, highlight}

endpoints.note: Category tab index with deeplinks; not used by the client (ranking-filters gives the snos the ranking API accepts).

notImplemented.body: {uid, goods_sno} (sent when a landing URL has ?uid=)
